blocks.text: A Recap of the HKL Journey

Since the launch of the HKL Global Movement in Amritsar, India on November 13, 2024, seven additional transformative conferences have taken place in Parma, Italy; Vancouver, Canada; Bulandpuri, Punjab; Sydney; Australia, Telford; UK and Toronto; Canada. Together, these gatherings have drawn more than 23,000 attendees in person and over half a million participants online. What began as a vision has now reached 116 countries and territories and continues to accelerate with remarkable momentum.
